summary: National Healthcare Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the closing of a registered underwritten public offering of 38,500,000 (plus 5,775,000 overallotment) shares of Class A common stock, and the amendment of its operating partnership agreement to reflect the removal of a special limited partnership interest, conversion of Class B units, and redemption rights. This is a routine capital markets transaction with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private. The filing is an ordinary equity offering update, not falling into any special-situations category.
